purpose: Shared advisory intake catalogs and readiness snapshots, configurable 30-minute reuse, one compiled configuration and batched local refs
scope: Fresh CLI processes against disposable local bare remotes. Readiness only: no Story, model, application test or approval in measured commands. OS caches are not flushed.
remoteFacingGitOperations: Counted ls-remote, fetch, clone and push invocations; fixture remotes are local filesystem paths, not enterprise network requests.

windowsCatalogCacheUnderParallelFunction.note: Native repository-location fallback; catalog service and remote work were bypassed.

realMacWorkspace.effects: Readiness only; no Story creation or remote writes. User checkouts preserved.

qualification.gitBypassAudit: 1786 existing reviewed production sites; no new unreviewed sites
qualification.windowsBroaderLifecycleResults: 90/91 passed. Only failure was an LF-string expectation for correctly preserved CRLF checkout bytes, subsequently corrected and independently rechecked.

knownBaselineFailure.test: test/configuration-branch.test.mjs: Story start recovers from a verified state mirror when sflow/config is unavailable
knownBaselineFailure.evidence: Reproduced in isolated Mac runs on unchanged ff86ec1 and candidate; the configuration-integrity suite passed 66/67. Not attributed to readiness changes or silently waived as green.

limitations: Two repeated samples and one cold-download sample per fixture; not statistical host qualification or a latency SLA.
Request names are harness positions: the baseline cache-hit positions still run fresh checks; an after cache-fill position may already reuse the first successful snapshot.
No office proxy, credentials, antivirus policy or cloud-offloaded directory was reproduced; Windows is native hosted CI, not the office laptop.

Before and after run sequentially on the same host, so OS/executable caches and host load may favor or penalize the later run. Earlier large-Windows cold samples regressed; do not infer a universal first-download speedup.
Readiness cache hits remove repeated Git work; actual initial downloads and authoritative Start remain real work. Catalog hits may retain one local native Git location lookup on Windows.
Windows performance run's two measurement jobs passed; its overall run failed on a portable UI test expectation corrected in later native qualification, not on a performance job.
Subsequent catalog/UI compatibility changes do not alter the measured selected-base readiness branch. Mac measurements include latest main; final functional qualification also includes latest main.
Temporary CI workflow files are never merged into main; their branch is deleted after evidence retention.
